entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: ¶For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: if indeed you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which was given to me for you,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: how that by revelation He made known to me the mystery (as I have briefly written already,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: by which, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ),

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to His holy apostles and prophets:

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: that the Gentiles should be fellow heirs, of the same body, and partakers of His promise in Christ through the gospel,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: of which I became a minister according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effective working of His power.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: To me, who am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: and to make all see what [is] the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the ages has been hidden in God who created all things through Jesus Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: to the intent that now the manifold wisdom of God might be made known by the church to the principalities and powers in the heavenly [places],

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: according to the eternal purpose which He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through faith in Him.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: Therefore I ask that you do not lose heart at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: ¶For this reason I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: from whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might through His Spirit in the inner man,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: may be able to comprehend with all the saints what [is] the width and length and depth and height--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: to know the love of Christ which passes knowledge; that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: Now to Him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: to Him [be] glory in the church by Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
